name: Residential / Homes
summary: For bedrooms, living rooms, apartments, and condos. Prioritizes quiet operation, energy efficiency, and affordability.

types.recommendation: Best for small bedrooms and rental units. Most affordable option.
Best for living rooms, master bedrooms, and condos. Quiet and energy-efficient with inverter tech.

name: Offices & Coworking Spaces
summary: For cubicle farms, private offices, and flexible workspaces. Prioritizes even cooling, quiet operation, and low maintenance.

types.recommendation: Good for small offices under 50sqm. Multiple units for larger spaces.
Standard choice for modern offices with drop ceilings. 4-way airflow covers the whole floor.
Ideal for offices with high ceilings or concrete walls. Strong airflow at desk level.

name: Commercial & Industrial
summary: For restaurants, retail stores, and large buildings. Prioritizes capacity, durability, and multi-zone control.

types.recommendation: Standard for retail and restaurants with drop ceilings.
Best for hotels, large offices, and high-end spaces where invisible cooling is required.
Good for warehouses, factories, and buildings without ceiling space.

name: Retail Shops & Showrooms
summary: For stores, boutiques, and exhibition spaces. Prioritizes appearance, even cooling, and durability under high foot traffic.

types.recommendation: Discreet ceiling installation keeps the space looking clean.
Good for smaller shops. Indoor unit can be placed high and out of the way.
